{{Top|leg}}
'''"Hanchin-set"''' was a term used to describe the setting of [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Hanchin]] below the horizon of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Qina/Legends|Qina]]. The term was developed by the natives to the moon to describe the phenomena by which a portion of Qina's surface was not covered by light. One of these rare and brief occasions occurred at mid-winter. During this Hanchin-set, the [[Vashan]] [[bodhis]] were known to cough up [[sin-bullet]]s.

The phenomena of a Hanchin-set caused darkness over a portion of the moon, because light radiated and reflected from the gas giant and bathed Qina in a measure of light for the majority of the year.
